title: BUYER BEWARE! You get what you pay for!
text: BUYER BEWARE! You get what you pay for!. The quality of these bowls is very poor.  I have only hand-washed the bowls and lids and only one of the lids fits well.  The large bowl lid doesn't even begin to fit! The large bowl bottom pops in and out, which is indicative of poor craftsmanship! LOOK FOR SOMETHING ELSE!!!

product_metadata.title: Bellemain Stainless Steel Non-Slip Mixing Bowls with Lids (4-Piece Set)
features: STAINLESS STEEL MIXING BOWL 4 PIECE SET (1.5, 3, 5, 7 QUART), MULTICOLOR: This multi-purpose bowl set is made with high quality stainless steel and comes with airtight BPA free silicone lids for a long life of use in your kitchen.
BEAUTIFUL MIRROR FINISH: MAKESmakes preparing food a delight. Great for food prep, mixing, storing and serving.
ENGRAVED MEASUREMENT LINES: Are helpful and easy to read. Measure, mix and store in one bowl. Bowls are dishwasher, freezer and oven safe.
MIXING BOWLS NEST AND STACK: Bowls nest into one another for storage. For refrigerator storage, use the tight fit lids and stack to save space.
NON-SLIP SILICONE, WEIGHTED BOWL BOTTOMS: Prevent sliding for ease in mixing your favorite ingredients and baked goods.
